journal_lines: Hollow in the rock, purple-lined. Geode.
Amethyst cluster. Chimed when I worked it.
Crystal lining in the geode. Careful work.
Purple light from inside the stone. Good find.
The geode opened like a flower that had been waiting a long time.
Crystals like teeth, set in a mouth that had not closed for ages.
Purple chimed against purple, soft as bells under water.
Did not crack the big one. Left it for the next wolf, or the next age.
Amethyst in the paw is colder than the stone around it. Always.
The hollow smelled like nothing. Truly nothing. Held my breath out of respect.
Picked the small clusters. Left the wall intact, mostly.
Light went in. Less light came out. Could not say where the rest went.
